decisions.reason: The plans README allows Candidate none with a reason and the project has no roadmap; I added a line to the plan saying a roadmap can be written first if the owner wants the trace.
The plan had no review step. I added to the assumptions that each increment follows run-increment, is reviewed and has the review recorded in Result before its commit.

Checked library.md: it specifies two roots and a config under the config directory. Setup now takes a bulk root and an index root, with the marker and device check, and the config lives outside both roots.

Checked book.md Safe writing: payloads go through an incoming area with verify and rename and are read-only. Increment B now builds that with interruption tests, and increment E writes derived output the same way.

The finding is right that book.md files a listing as a pointer. I took the exclusion route: the engine does not detect page shape, listings are outside the slice and off the walk-through address list, and the plan says so.
Increment J is now optional, and completion criterion 6 accepts either a recorded walk-through or a recorded owner decline.

Checked library.md and reading.md: a read command takes no path, address or token and the host settings are owner-only. Increment I now reads the engine location only from the owner-only config as a same-machine interface, and the plan states it is narrower than the host service and names I as the part to defer.

Checked pipeline.md: a scan stage and recorded stage states are required. Stage state is now in increment B with the capture increments setting it, the scan is in increment E, and conversion, indexing and a resume command follow the states in F and G.
Added step 0 to increment E, a stop that asks the owner whether to run the security-review module and records the answer, and rewrote the risk text to say so.
Increment G now returns the version caveats, the date added and the completeness and partial status in each result, and tests that a flagged fixture keeps them through a rebuild.

A crash between promotion and the stage update was a real gap: increment B now adopts a valid promoted result on resume and tests that interruption, and increment G repeats the test for each stage that writes a payload.
